acquisition_method.evidence: MS data were acquired using a DDA top 15 method, and the survey full scan MS spectra (300–1,750 Th) were acquired in the Orbitrap with 60000 resolution, AGC target 1e6, IT 120 m.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: A slice around 175 kDa was excised and free thiols cysteines were N-ethylmaleimide alkylated by 55mM NEM; then oxidized thiols were reduced by 10 mM DTT and alkylated by 55 mM IAA; proteins were digested overnight by trypsin.
